description_en: Lists all importable KMS secrets for a specified host
description_zh: 列出指定主机所有可导入的 KMS 凭据
name: ListImportableKMSSecretsForHost

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to get this ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For details about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to get this ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the secret to search for. Fuzzy matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的凭据名称。模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The token to retrieve the next page of results.

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the `NextToken` value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh:
游标查询下次查询所需的Token。
首次查询时留空，下次请求时传上次查询返回值中的NextToken字段值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的条数。不填时默认查询20条
parameters.name: max_results

MaxResults.description_en: The value of the `MaxResults` parameter in the request. If the parameter was not specified, the default value of 20 is returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 请求参数中传了有效MaxResults时返回请求时所传的值，否则返回默认值

NextToken.description_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. If this field is empty, all results have been returned

SecretType.description_en:
The type of the secret. Valid value:

`ECS`: an ECS secret
SecretType.description_zh:
凭据类型。取值：

ECS：ECS凭据

Tags.description_en: The tags associated with the secret
